articles.summary: Nintendo is officially joining PlayStation and Xbox in launching its own official Black Friday sale for this year. Alongside a very welcome Switch 2 console deal, the sale is also stacked with plenty of physical game deals for the OG Switch and Switch 2.
body: We've never seen the price for this game drop this low before, which certainly makes the deal a highlight among Nintendo's Black Friday sale selection.

If you've been saving a spot for it in your Switch 2 library, now is a great time to buy. We certainly think the game is worth it, as not only did it earn a 10/10 review score but it's also among our 100 best Nintendo Games of all time and was our favorite Nintendo game of last year.
Donkey Kong Bananza's review featured some mighty high praise from IGN's Logan Plant, who called it "a truly groundbreaking 3D platformer".

Before the slog that was 2001’s Pearl Harbor and his divisive Transformers movies that simultaneously hurt and enhanced his career by sidelining him for decades, Bay debuted as a director with a trio of really exciting movies that prioritized a fun…
body: The Rock stars Sean Connery in one of his last great roles as John Patrick Mason, a cunning British Army officer who was imprisoned 30 years earlier without a trial​​​​​​​, for stealing classified U.S. information. He’s also the only man to ever escape Alcatraz, and the U.S. government​​​​​​​ is now offering him his freedom if he’ll help a team of Marines break into the long-shuttered prison he once broke out of.

Alcatraz, nicknamed “The Rock,” has been taken over by rogue Marine general Francis X. Hummel (Ed Harris) and a brigade​​​​​​​ of loyal soldiers. Hummel is bitter about the government covering up some Marine deaths during Operation: Desert Storm and now he’s demanding restitution for the families (and himself). He’s also holding Alcatraz tourists hostage​​​​​​​ and has deadly chemical weapons pointed at San Francisco, which he’ll fire into the city if they don’t comply.
That’s why the government also pairs Mason with bookish FBI agent Dr. Stanley Goodspeed​​​​​​​, a chemical weapons expert played by Nicolas Cage.

articles.title: GTA 6 player gets 30-day PSN ban for sharing in-game nudist photo with a friend
articles.summary: A Grand Theft Auto 6 player says they've been hit with a 30-day PlayStation Network ban after sending a friend a photo they took in the game's nudist resort.
body: Posting on Twitter/X on Friday evening, DerrickGott007 said they had "just got a 30-day PSN social features ban" for sending the photo, which they'd taken with the in-game camera, through PlayStation's messaging service, warning other players not to do the same.

"Do not, I repeat do not send any photos taken with the in-game camera, across the PSN messaging network that contain nudity," they wrote. "I just got a 30-day PSN social features ban for sending my friend a photo of the nudist colony in GTA6 that I found."

In a screenshot of the notice, PlayStation Safety says that content sent from the player's account via Message on PlayStation "breached the Code of Conduct", and that their account has been "temporarily suspended from using PlayStation social features for 30 days" due to "pornographic or obscene content". It also warns that "further offenses may result in temporary or permanent suspension from the whole of PlayStation, not just social features".

articles.title: Star Wars’ 2-Part Sci-Fi War Thriller Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
articles.summary: In 2022, Disney was having a pretty strange year with its franchises. There were some major wins, such as the hugely financially successful release of Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness and Turning Red becoming a streaming hit. Its films also earned $4.9 billion at the box office that year.
body: However, some franchises fared much worse with their fans than others. After the poor reception of The Book of Boba Fett in February and the controversy surrounding Obi-Wan Kenobi in May, Star Wars fans weren't particularly hopeful that Andor, Tony Gilroy’s gritty spy series, would restore the franchise to its former greatness.

Those fans were wrong. Gilroy didn’t just renew fans' hope that Star Wars could be more than a franchise for children; he delivered a culturally relevant story about the sacrifices people make — love, comfort, and friendship — in the fight against tyranny, all within a single season. The series also expanded the background of a beloved character, Cassian Andor, so that even if a second season had never arrived, that story would have worked perfectly as a sequel to Star Wars' most beloved films.

Though Andor ’s second season is more critically acclaimed — and has a handful of awards under its belt — its 12-episode first season is immaculate at showcasing how the Empire’s oppressive grip destroys the hope of those living under its regime. It also kickstarts Cassian Andor’s ascent into the hardcore rebel fans know from Rogue One.
points: In 2022, Disney was having a pretty strange year with its franchises.

articles.title: "It stayed alive for so long" - Behind the wheel with the Last Riders saying goodbye to GTA Online, amidst GTA 6's world-changing launch
articles.summary: In the decade or so since Grand Theft Auto Online 's arrival, its roads have become a kind of home; well-loved by its racers, its gear heads, and speed freaks. It's a game that allows players to lose themselves in the roleplay, the heists, and the crime sprees.
body: So when the GTA Online community decided to host Last Ride events this week - a sort of mass in-game road trip and a communal farewell before attention inevitably turned to GTA 6 - I was keen to join in. The Last Drive was scheduled to begin an hour before GTA 6's launch, and would see numerous groups embarking on their own journey across GTA Online's servers, all taking the same route: starting at Los Santos' Del Perro Pier and following the highway around Los Santos' entire perimeter before finally rolling up to its airport. Players would then fly off into the sunset, close the game, and move on. Some just for a while, others perhaps forever.

Kirsty is one of the many long-time players who chose to embark on their own last drive as part of the event. She runs the Fast Crew racing community in GTA Online and has been playing since the beginning in 2013, even meeting her fiance through the game. Unlike some, however, she plans to stick around in GTA Online after GTA 6's release, at least until the new game's equivalent comes along.

articles.title: 29 years later, Homer’s Best ‘The Simpsons’ Quote is Still Pure Genius
articles.summary: Personally, my favorite-ever quote from Homer Simpson came during season 4 of The Simpsons, in an episode named “Whacking Day.” The episode is about the citizens of Springfield celebrating a local holiday named Whacking Day, when they lure all the snakes in Springfield to the center of town and…
body: Depressed at being the only one in Springfield who cares about the fate of the snakes, Lisa turns to her father.
“Dad! Everyone likes Whacking Day, but I hate it. Is there something wrong with me?” asks Lisa.
“Just squeeze your rage into a bitter little ball and release it at an appropriate time. Like that day I hit the referee with a whiskey bottle. Remember that?”

This is one of those lines from The Simpsons that didn’t just make me laugh, but kept running in my head over and over again for days afterward. Eventually, I realized it was because it pretty perfectly described my own rage issues, like when I would lash out at an especially slow driver in front of me, or some telemarketer who, at most, deserved only mild rage for trying to sell me a new warranty on my car.

articles.title: Over half of all console players active on GTA 6's launch day played it, says Circana
articles.summary: On Grand Theft Auto 6 's launch day, more than half of everyone playing on PS5 and Xbox was playing GTA 6.
body: Citing new data from Circana's Player Engagement Tracker, analyst Mat Piscatella said on Bluesky that 61 percent of US PlayStation 5 players and 56 percent of global Xbox players who were active on 19th November "engaged with Grand Theft Auto 6".
PS5 players averaged 513 minutes in GTA 6 that day, which is over eight and a half hours, while Xbox players averaged 494 minutes, or around eight and a quarter hours.
"Both the DAU [daily active users] and minutes played engagement rates are absolutely bonkers," Piscatella wrote.
For comparison, Fortnite had the second-highest engagement rate that day, with 10 percent of active players across both platforms playing it.

articles.title: Jason's stoic character in Grand Theft Auto 6 was inspired by Steve McQueen and research into Army veterans: 'These guys typically aren't running their mouths'
articles.summary: It's already clear that Grand Theft Auto 6 has a very different timbre than most other GTA games. While criminal hijinks and acerbic satire remain part of the experience, it's also much more interested in portraying characters and relationships in a more convincing, human fashion.
body: One of the most striking examples of this is its depiction of co-protagonist Jason Duval, who, unlike the vast majority of GTA's main characters, is often notable for what he doesn't say rather than what he does. According to Rockstar's senior vice president of narrative Rupert Humphries, Jason's laconic nature was inspired by a personality type observed in both cinema and real-life.

"When we decided we wanted to tell a story about a couple on the run, we looked at all the similar kinds of movies, and one of the ones that really stood out was [Sam] Peckinpah's The Getaway" Humphries explained in a statement given to Destructoid (via GamesRadar ). Steve McQueen was famous for pulling lines out of scripts and saying things with his presence alone. We wanted to see how close we could get to that with a game character, where so many of our protagonists have been the opposite."
points: It's already clear that Grand Theft Auto 6 has a very different timbre than most other GTA games.
While criminal hijinks and acerbic satire remain part of the experience, it's also much more interested in portraying characters and relationships in a more convincing, human fashion.

articles.title: Astarion's Baldur's Gate 3 prequel novel infuriated fans, now it's Shadowheart's turn
articles.summary: Tasha Suri, author of the Burning Kingdoms trilogy and several other books, will be writing Baldur's Gate 3: Shadowheart, the official BG3books website has announced. Another prequel to Larian's videogame, this one focuses on Shadowheart's time as a priestess in the Church of Shar, and is about a…
body: "When a member of their order is killed in the Upper City," the blurb goes, "Shadowheart and her so-called allies are called to investigate. She trusts none of them: not Mirie, the ambitious Griefguard; not Caldan, the cynical propagandist; and certainly not Nocturne, the charming quartermistress, who claims to have only Shadowheart’s best interests in mind."

Mirie and Nocturne are both characters you can meet in Baldur's Gate 3, while Caldan Darkwood is mentioned in a note you can find. Nocturne in particular has a close relationship with Shadowheart, which could be interesting to see developed. "Torn between the familiar comforts of the dark and the thrill of new desire," the blurb continues, "she must solve the mystery to prove her devotion… or be cast into the light."

Which sounds fine and dandy, but it'll have an uphill battle with the Baldur's Gate 3 fandom, who've been vocally critical of the Astarion novel for its lightness of tone—especially given his traumatic backstory—and apparently mischaracterizing Astarion and his sire, Cazador, as well as being inaccurate to the lore.

points: "PSYCHO DEAD" is a third-person survival horror game centered on Elixia, a mysterious girl with psychic powers, who must escape a secret laboratory infested with grotesque and monstrous creatures.
Explore a sci-fi setting filled with mystery and danger, where terror awaits at every corner, and discover the truth behind the horrific incident.

videos.title: Arknights: Endfield - Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms Version Trailer | PS5 Games
body: Indications: Hallucinations such as seeing angry mushrooms roll up their sleeves and come at you, Protocol Dataloggers saying hello to you, or mushroom caps stealthily sprouting on your head.
Dosage and Administration: Aim for the forehead. One piece at a time. Throw with all your strength.
Side Effects: You may feel a little dazed for a short while after regaining consciousness. This product accepts no liability for any such effects.
